description: This is a React component implementing a client for an interactive mind map feature in a career navigation app. It manages state, fetches data from APIs, handles user interactions, and renders UI components including filters, debug info, and panels for node and role details.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number within a specified min and max range.

methods.name: defaultFilters
methods.description: Provides default filter settings for the mind map filters.

methods.name: defaultState
methods.description: Initial default state for the mind map view, including pan, zoom, filters, and selected nodes.

methods.name: toSafeState
methods.description: Converts an unknown object into a valid MindmapViewState, applying defaults and validating types.

methods.name: safeErrorMessage
methods.description: Converts an unknown error object into a user-friendly error message string.

methods.name: getUserKey
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a stable anonymous user key for identification.

methods.name: computeEmptyStateReason
methods.description: Determines the reason why the mind map is empty or cannot be displayed.

methods.name: DebugRow
methods.description: A React component used for displaying debug information rows.

methods.name: MindmapClient
methods.description: Main React functional component for the mind map page, handling state, data fetching, and rendering the interface.
